Apotheosis is the process of [[ascension]] while maintaining a state of [[nobility]]. It contrasts with [[faustery]] which is ascension without maintaining a state of [[nobility]].<ref name=":0">https://evolution.faith/the-paths-of-ascension/</ref>

Apotheosis creates [[Kami]], and [[faustery]] creates [[oni|Archons]]<ref name=":0" />
